y_failures: Says planet-to-interval mappings 'e.g., Saturn to the lowest notes' are 'detailed in Macrobius' p.595, but that page only gives the general Pythagorean idea of sphere-sound; the bullet 'Jovial music: used for civil business and legal success' (p.163) also stretches a page that says civil business places one under Jupiter, not that Jovial music is used for it.
reason: All of X's quotations (Kircher pp.406 and 180, Mersenne p.741) match the page text, while Y attaches some claims to pages that don't support them. Y covers Ficino in more depth, but grounding outweighs that.
